copy.lostFound.title: Lost & found
copy.lostFound.intro: Tell us what you lost or found. Tournament staff will help connect it with its owner.
copy.lostFound.privacyTitle: A private report, not a public listing
copy.lostFound.privacy: Only authorized tournament staff can read your report. If we send a confirmation, our email service receives your email address and receipt number, not your item description. Your name and phone number are optional.
copy.lostFound.safety: Do not include passwords, ID numbers, or other sensitive details. Keep found items safe and ask a volunteer where to hand them in. For urgent or safety concerns, speak to staff in person.
copy.lostFound.descriptionHint: Include the color, brand, and a distinguishing feature. 5–2000 characters.
copy.lostFound.locationLabel: Where was it lost or found?
copy.lostFound.locationHint: A building, room, or nearby landmark. Write Unknown if you are unsure.
copy.lostFound.timeLabel: When was it lost or found?
copy.lostFound.timeHint: An approximate time is fine, for example November 14, around 10 am Pacific.
copy.lostFound.emailHint: Use an address you can check. A parent or guardian’s email is welcome. We request a confirmation email when you submit; the receipt below will show its status separately from the saved report.
copy.lostFound.mailQueued: Confirmation email is queued, not yet accepted by the mail provider. Your report is saved; do not submit it again.
copy.lostFound.mailNotConfigured: Your report is saved. Email confirmation is unavailable, so keep this receipt number for follow-up.
copy.lostFound.mailSending: Confirmation email is being attempted. Acceptance is not confirmed. Your report is saved.
copy.lostFound.mailRetryWait: The mail provider has not accepted the confirmation. A limited retry is scheduled. Your report is saved.
copy.lostFound.mailAccepted: Your confirmation is on its way. Check your spam folder if it does not arrive, and keep this receipt number.
copy.lostFound.mailFailed: Confirmation email could not be sent. Your report is saved. Keep the receipt and ask staff for help; do not resubmit the report.
copy.lostFound.mailUncertain: Email acceptance is uncertain. We will not automatically resend because that could duplicate the email. Your report is saved; staff can check the mail provider and help.
copy.lostFound.mailHandled: Staff recorded manual follow-up for the confirmation. This is not proof of email delivery. Your report remains saved.
copy.lostFound.mailUnknown: Email status is unavailable. Keep your saved receipt and ask staff for help.
copy.lostFound.successTitle: Your report is with tournament staff
copy.lostFound.successBody: Save this receipt if you need to speak with staff. It confirms your report was stored, not a match or return. The receipt does not let anyone view your report online. Email status is a separate snapshot, not a delivery guarantee.
copy.lostFound.editingPaused: Editing is paused until we confirm this attempt. Retry uses the original report, not a new submission.
copy.lostFound.submitUncertain: We could not confirm whether your report arrived. Your details are still here. Retry the same report; the same submission key prevents a duplicate.
copy.lostFound.mailRefreshError: Could not refresh email status. Your report is already saved. Keep the receipt; do not submit the report again.
copy.lostFound.errorAuth: This request could not be completed. Ask a volunteer for help.
copy.lostFound.errorConflict: This request key was already used. Retry the same report or ask a volunteer for help; keep your details.
copy.lostFound.errorTooLarge: This report is too large. Shorten the description and try again.
copy.lostFound.errorInvalid: Check the fields and their length limits, then try again. A usable contact email is required.
copy.lostFound.errorRateLimited: Too many reports or requests. Wait 30 minutes, or ask a volunteer for help.

guide.title: Your BMT visitor guide
guide.intro: Prepare for your visit, find your way and make the most of tournament day.

sections.title: Before you arrive
sections.markdown:
Check the [schedule](/schedule) for arrival and round times, and allow time to find your first room. Keep your student ID handy for [My rooms](/rooms).

- Bring pencils, erasers and a water bottle.
- Agree on a meeting point with your coach or family.
- Plan your journey with [TakeTransit](https://taketransit.berkeley.mt/).

sections.title: Finding your room
sections.markdown:
Enter your student ID in [My rooms](/rooms) to see your assigned rooms. Choose **Directions** beside a round to see its building, floor and entrance.

The [campus map](/map) helps you get your bearings. Need a step-free route or cannot find your destination? Ask a volunteer before setting off.
sections.imageAlt: Campus orientation map; not a confirmed November tournament room map

sections.title: During the day
sections.markdown:
Check [live updates](/updates) for organizer announcements and schedule changes. A scheduled start is not a signal to begin a round: follow your proctor’s instructions.

Keep personal belongings with you. If you find or lose an item, use the public help tools or ask staff. Do not post personal contact details in a public description.

sections.title: Accessibility and help
sections.markdown:
Visit [Help](/help) for Wi-Fi, restrooms and the information desk. A volunteer can help with room directions or accessibility needs.

For an immediate emergency, contact local emergency services. Do not wait for an online report to be read.

help.title: Urgent help
help.markdown: For an immediate emergency, contact local emergency services and alert a nearby staff member. Online reports are not monitored for emergencies.

help.title: Wi-Fi
help.markdown: Ask the information desk for the current guest network and connection instructions.

help.title: Information desk
help.markdown: Need directions, your room assignment or help with the day’s schedule? Ask a BMT volunteer to point you to the information desk.

help.title: Restrooms
help.markdown: Follow the restroom signs in your building, or ask a volunteer for the nearest accessible restroom.

help.title: Questions or lost items
help.markdown: Check the [FAQ](/faq) for common questions. Lost something? [Send a private report](/lost-found) with a description and a way to reach you. Staff will contact you if they find a match.
